scope: Android Gradle declarations, native Kotlin imports/platform use, bundled font notices, manifest and production verification receipts. Map data, terrain/imagery provider terms and self-hosting are separately audited by parent. No resolved transitive SBOM was produced here.

components: Kotlin standard runtime through Kotlin Android 2.2.21

runtimeDependencies.qualification: Direct OkHttp version is source-pinned; this audit does not claim to have resolved the transitive Okio version.

proprietarySdkScan.conclusion: No direct commercial map, Google Play Services, Firebase, analytics or billing SDK declaration/import found in the scanned native source. This is not a complete resolved-binary/transitive license certification.

implementation.fact: Own bundled Tropnik Canvas inside platform android.webkit.WebView; native broker controls asset/network requests. The remaining MapLibre license is explicitly recorded as historical, not a current Gradle/runtime SDK declaration.
Platform LocationManager with optional GPS/network providers; accepts recent <=30s fix or subscribes for one fix with 20s timeout and removes listeners. No fused Play Services location dependency.

Manifest declares foreground coarse/fine location only; no background-location permission or location foreground service. Existing capability is locate-on-map, not tested continuous turn-by-turn guidance.
App uses Android platform WebView and AndroidKeyStore. Owning application code is not ownership of the device OS/WebView implementation.
Build tools are AGP 8.13.2, Kotlin 2.2.21, KSP 2.2.21-2.0.4. Dependency resolution uses Google Maven and Maven Central; plugin resolution additionally uses Gradle Plugin Portal.

licenseEvidenceLimit.fact: A generic Apache-2.0 text and Manrope OFL texts are bundled; SOURCES identifies the main runtime families. Packaging excludes duplicate META-INF/AL2.0 and META-INF/LGPL2.1 resources. No versioned resolved runtime-component license/NOTICE manifest or SBOM was found in tracked Android source.
licenseEvidenceLimit.interpretation: No violation is asserted from duplicate-license exclusion alone. Before describing all dependencies as cleared, compare resolved components and required notices with the distributed APK.

releaseGaps.fact: b8 executes 13 device cases, passes12, fails compact font200 label overflow. Narrow fix is prepared but not yet accepted on a new device run.

b8 production receipt is unsigned-production-build-check, signatureVerified=false, signingCertificateSha256=null and productionPublished=false. A signed candidate needs externally managed keystore, both passwords, non-debug alias and independently pinned certificate SHA256.

Signed preflight requires configured HTTPS TROPA_API_BASE_URL. Receipt marks liveApiVerified=false and upgradeVerified=false. Source supports own API origin and explicit unconfigured state; the passing fixture case does not prove live hosted service.
Actual CI uses x86_64 API35 emulator with ANGLE/SwiftShader. Receipt explicitly marks ARM64/physical device execution false and excludes GPS, battery and online satellite-provider verification.

changesMade: None for this inventory; native UX fix is separate.
